A certificate of competence or a license or seal as a master fire suppression piping contractor shall be issued only to an individual.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
